hello-ai.yml
cases.source:
schemaVersion: 1
id: hello-ai
version: 1.0.0
requires: [runtime.message.send]
commands:
  - name: helloai
    permission: aetherscript.example.hello
    sender: any
    actions:
      - type: message.send
        target: sender
        text: "Hello from AetherScript!"
